label_rationale: SimonMed is a large independent outpatient imaging center chain operating across multiple US states offering MRI, CT, PET, mammography and other services.
RadNet is one of the largest US outpatient imaging operators with hundreds of freestanding centers offering MRI, CT, X-ray, ultrasound and mammography.
Envision Imaging is an independent outpatient imaging center group in Texas offering MRI, CT and X-ray services at multiple freestanding locations.
CDI is a national US outpatient imaging company offering MRI, CT, PET, ultrasound and mammography at freestanding centers.
Shields operates independent outpatient MRI centers in New England and is a US-based freestanding imaging provider.
Houston Methodist is a major hospital system with imaging departments, not an independent outpatient imaging center. Should be reviewed to determine if its imaging division qualifies separately.
Memorial Hermann is an integrated health system. Its imaging services exist within the hospital context and require human review.
Cantel Medical manufactures infection prevention products for endoscopy and is not an imaging center or radiology provider.
Alliance HealthCare provides mobile and fixed-site MRI, CT, PET and other outpatient imaging services across the US.
NIA (radmd.com) is a radiology benefit management company that manages imaging authorization for health plans — not an imaging center itself.
